name: usage-pace
description: Adds a pace indicator for your 5h and 7d usage to your existing status line, and can tint the session color to match.

sessionColor.title: Session color follows pace
sessionColor.description: Run /color green, yellow or red as the chosen window's pace changes; worse follows whichever window is further over pace.

aheadIsPositive.title: Ahead of pace is positive
aheadIsPositive.description: Show being under pace as a positive number instead of a negative one.

threshold.title: On-track band
threshold.description: Points either side of pace that still count as on track (yellow).

showCountdown.title: Show 5h reset countdown
showCountdown.description: Append how long until the 5-hour window resets.
